approved.checks: The normal approved path: both external checks pass, the transfer completes, and the payer receives the completion notification.
approved.inspect_for: payment_outcome=completed, a successful TRANSFER_FUNDS_TO_PAYEE, the completion notification, and PAYMENT_COMPLETED.

denied.checks: A denied fraud result starts automatic compensation.
denied.inspect_for: refund_reason=denied, successful REFUND_PAYER and ROLLBACK_PAYMENT_STATUS, payment_outcome=refunded, and PAYMENT_REFUNDED.

suspicious.checks: A suspicious fraud result triggers the security notification and automatic compensation.
suspicious.inspect_for: refund_reason=suspicious, security notification, successful refund and rollback, payment_outcome=refunded, and PAYMENT_REFUNDED.

manual-review-required.checks: The process activates the manual-review user task and makes its form available in Tasklist.
manual-review-required.inspect_for: The active manual-review task and its approved/denied form choices; payment_outcome is not set before a decision.

manual-review-approved.checks: An approved manual-review decision continues to the payee transfer.
manual-review-approved.inspect_for: manual_decision=approved, successful transfer and completion notification, payment_outcome=completed, and PAYMENT_COMPLETED.

manual-review-denied.checks: A denied manual-review decision starts automatic compensation.
manual-review-denied.inspect_for: manual_decision=denied, refund_reason=manual_denied, successful refund and rollback, payment_outcome=refunded, and PAYMENT_REFUNDED.

fraud-check-failure.checks: A failure in PERFORM_FRAUD_CHECK throws CHECK_FAILED and takes the process through compensation.
fraud-check-failure.inspect_for: CHECK_FAILED handling, refund_reason=check_failed, successful refund and rollback, payment_outcome=refunded, and PAYMENT_REFUNDED.

external-check-failure.checks: A failed simulated external check throws CHECK_FAILED and takes the process through compensation.
external-check-failure.inspect_for: The failed compliance check, CHECK_FAILED handling, refund_reason=check_failed, successful refund and rollback, and PAYMENT_REFUNDED.

debit-failure.checks: A debit failure means payer funds were not captured, so compensation must not run.
debit-failure.inspect_for: payment_outcome=failed_system and PAYMENT_FAILED_SYSTEM; no REFUND_PAYER or ROLLBACK_PAYMENT_STATUS.

transfer-failure.checks: A known transfer failure triggers compensation because the payee transfer did not take effect.
transfer-failure.inspect_for: TRANSFER_FAILED, refund_reason=transfer_failed, successful refund and rollback, payment_outcome=refunded, and PAYMENT_REFUNDED.

refund-failure.checks: A permanent refund failure must block compensation and leave the process incident at the refund task.
refund-failure.inspect_for: An incident at REFUND_PAYER; no rollback and no payment_outcome=refunded.

rollback-failure.checks: A permanent rollback failure must block the refunded outcome after the refund succeeds.
rollback-failure.inspect_for: Successful REFUND_PAYER followed by an incident at ROLLBACK_PAYMENT_STATUS; no payment_outcome=refunded.

refund-transient-retry.checks: A transient refund failure is retried once and then succeeds.
refund-transient-retry.inspect_for: One failed REFUND_PAYER attempt followed by success, successful rollback, payment_outcome=refunded, and PAYMENT_REFUNDED.

rollback-transient-retry.checks: A transient rollback failure is retried once and then succeeds.
rollback-transient-retry.inspect_for: Successful refund, one failed ROLLBACK_PAYMENT_STATUS attempt followed by success, payment_outcome=refunded, and PAYMENT_REFUNDED.
